dct_title_s: Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) - Flood on Jun 27 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250627-VEN-01](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250627-VEN-01) A flood occurred on Jun 27 2025 in Venezuela. It affected an estimated 57003 people and 100038 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
